title: Watcher Greatsword

fields.Weapon profile: 3d12 Slashing plus Strength. Martial, two-handed melee, 5 ft. Only Steel Watchers can equip it.
fields.Acquisition: Find one in the foundry or pick it up after disarming a Steel Watcher. The Patch 3 equip restriction prevents player use.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
